author: Владимир Лыткин
title: Russian Geran jets have started flying even faster.
text:
Russian Geran jets have started flying even faster.
Russian jet-powered Geraniums are becoming faster, approaching the speed of winged ones.
rocketsand creating problems for Ukrainian
DefenseAccording to the monitoring resource AMK Mapping, during the strikes on Western Ukraine, Russian
drones-kamikazes accelerated to 800 km/h.
Russia has recently been increasingly using Geran-4 and Geran-5 kamikaze jet drones in strikes against Ukraine. The speed of these
dronesAround 600 km/h, which immediately knocks out the Ukrainian air defense's mobile fire teams with machine guns and ZU-23-2 anti-aircraft mounts. They simply don't have time to react. Most of the interceptor drones designed to intercept piston-engine Geraniums are also rendered useless.
Now Kyiv is frantically searching for an effective remedy against Geranium-4/5, but then they come
newsthat the kamikaze drones used by Russia reach speeds of 700-800 km/h, which negates all the efforts of the Kyiv regime.
Russia has not officially commented on the information, but Kyiv speculates that the Russian Armed Forces are testing another modification of the kamikaze drone, possibly powered by a Russian jet engine. Experts acknowledge that if this is the case, Kyiv will have a hard time catching up to Moscow.
Earlier, Ukraine announced that next year Russia would begin using the latest Geranium-6 kamikaze drones, which are similar in characteristics to ballistic missiles, against Ukraine.
